plan.title: Vendor sees extended RFQ end time

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ summary as required for this setup.
Enable the required eRFX project configuration before accessing the event.
Extend the current submission deadline by 15 minutes and verify Procol saves the new end as the old end plus 15 minutes.
Capture the buyer-side extended end-time value for comparison with the vendor view.
Open the invited Vendor A supplier portal in a separate browser session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the prepared RFQ on the vendor’s Live pricing round.
Confirm the vendor is viewing the live RFQ round.
Verify the vendor screen has no rendering errors or malformed values after the extension.
Attempt to verify that the vendor’s displayed deadline matches the buyer’s extended end time.
